HeyGen TTS Tool Free v1.0.0

- Initial release of HeyGen TTS (Starfish model) skill for personal use.
- Supports text-to-speech in 40+ languages with basic speed control (0.5–2.0x).
- Allows voice selection, pause tags (`<break time="1s"/>`), and audio download via `audio_url`.
- Includes quick start guides, code samples (Python/cURL), best practices, and troubleshooting.
- Advanced features (SSML, batch, time stamps, API service, multi-lingual mixing) are available only in the Pro version.
